name: GitLab
description: Let agents read merge requests, pipelines, job logs, commits and code in the GitLab projects you choose, and comment on merge requests. For review prep, failed pipeline triage, release checks, status reports and building from a project's code.
identity: A GitLab project or group access token. It acts as a bot member of that project or group, with the role you give it, and reaches nothing outside it.

setup.title: Create an access token
setup.body: Create the token on the group that holds the projects agents should see, or on one project. Give it the Reporter role and the read_api scope. If agents may comment on merge requests, keep the Reporter role and choose the api scope instead: Reporter can comment but cannot push code, merge or run pipelines. GitLab shows the token only once.
click: In GitLab, open the group (or the project), then select Settings > Access tokens > Add new token.
Token name: AI agents. Set an expiration date.
Role: Reporter. Scopes: read_api (api if agents may comment).
Select Create group access token (or Create project access token) and copy the token.

setup.title: Find your GitLab address
setup.body: Enter the host name of your GitLab, such as gitlab.com or gitlab.example.com, without https://. You can test the token with the command below: it shows the token's bot user and changes nothing.
click: Copy the host name from your browser's address bar while you are in GitLab.

fields.label: GitLab address
fields.help: The host name only, such as gitlab.com or gitlab.example.com.

capabilities.label: Read merge requests and pipelines
capabilities.description: List and read merge requests with their changes and comments, list and read pipelines and their jobs, read a job's log, and list commits.
capabilities.note: Reaches every project the token can see unless you keep a key to chosen projects. Read-only.

capabilities.label: Read code
capabilities.description: Find the commit a branch or tag points to, list a project's files, read a file, and download the code of one commit as an archive.
capabilities.note: Read-only. Anyone holding the key can read the whole code of each project it may reach, so keep it to the projects it needs.

capabilities.label: Comment on merge requests
capabilities.description: Add a comment to a merge request, such as a review brief. It can be marked internal, so only project members see it.
capabilities.note: Needs a token with the api scope. Keep its role at Reporter.

limits.label: Projects
limits.help: Optional: only these projects, by their full path as in the project's address, such as platform/payments-api. Agents must then name projects by that path. Leave empty for every project the token can see.

revoke: In GitLab, open the group or project, go to Settings > Access tokens and revoke the token. Agents lose access to GitLab at once.

tools.name: gitlab_list_merge_requests
tools.description: List a project's merge requests, newest first. Pass next from the answer as page for the next page.

project.description: The project's full path, such as platform/payments-api, or its numeric id

state.description: Only merge requests in this state

target_branch.description: Only those merging into this branch

labels.description: Comma-separated labels, all of which must be on the merge request

author_username.description: Only those opened by this username

search.description: Words in the title or description

updated_after.description: Only those updated after this time, ISO 8601, such as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z

per_page.description: How many per page, at most 100

page.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: gitlab_get_merge_request
tools.description: Read one merge request: description, branches, approvals state, merge status and its latest pipeline.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

iid.description: The merge request number within the project (its iid)

tools.name: gitlab_list_merge_request_changes
tools.description: List the files a merge request changes, with each file's diff. Pass next from the answer as page for the next page.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

iid.description: The merge request number within the project (its iid)

per_page.description: How many files per page, at most 100

page.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: gitlab_list_merge_request_comments
tools.description: List the comments on a merge request, newest first, including system notes such as approvals. Pass next from the answer as page for the next page.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

iid.description: The merge request number within the project (its iid)

per_page.description: How many per page, at most 100

page.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: gitlab_list_pipelines
tools.description: List a project's pipelines, newest first. Pass next from the answer as page for the next page.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

ref.description: Only pipelines for this branch or tag

updated_after.description: Only those updated after this time, ISO 8601

per_page.description: How many per page, at most 100

page.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: gitlab_get_pipeline
tools.description: Read one pipeline: status, branch, commit, who started it, timing and the reason it failed, if GitLab gives one.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

tools.name: gitlab_list_pipeline_jobs
tools.description: List a pipeline's jobs with their stage, status and failure reason. Pass next from the answer as page for the next page.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

per_page.description: How many per page, at most 100

page.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: gitlab_get_job_log
tools.description: Read a job's log as text, to see why it failed. Logs larger than 1 MB cannot be read.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

tools.name: gitlab_list_commits
tools.description: List commits on a branch, newest first, optionally only within dates or by one author. Pass next from the answer as page for the next page.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

ref_name.description: The branch or tag; the default branch when left out

since.description: Only commits after this time, ISO 8601

until.description: Only commits before this time, ISO 8601

author.description: Only commits by this author name or email

per_page.description: How many per page, at most 100

page.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: gitlab_resolve_ref
tools.description: Find the commit a branch, tag or commit SHA points to. Its id is the full commit SHA that gitlab_download_archive takes.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

ref.description: A branch or tag name, or a commit SHA

tools.name: gitlab_list_tree
tools.description: List the files and folders in a project at a branch, tag or commit, in one folder or, with recursive, everything under it. Pass next from the answer as page for the next page.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

ref.description: A branch or tag name, or a commit SHA

path.description: The folder, such as src/lib; the top folder when left out

recursive.description: Also list everything inside each folder

per_page.description: How many per page, at most 100

page.description: The next value of the previous answer

tools.name: gitlab_read_file
tools.description: Read one file's content as text, at a branch, tag or commit. Files larger than 1 MB, and files that are not text, cannot be read here.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

file_path.description: The file's path in the project, such as src/index.ts

ref.description: A branch or tag name, or a commit SHA

tools.name: gitlab_download_archive
tools.description: Download the code of one commit as a .tar.gz archive, for a program to unpack, not for reading. Takes the full commit SHA only (gitlab_resolve_ref finds it for a branch or tag), so the same call always gives the same code. Archives larger than 8 MB are refused.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

sha.description: The full commit SHA, 40 lower-case hex characters (64 in a SHA-256 project)

tools.name: gitlab_add_merge_request_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a merge request. Markdown is allowed.

project.description: The project's full path or numeric id

iid.description: The merge request number within the project (its iid)

internal.description: Only project members can see it
